title: Andor enumeration exceeds the eight-device storage capacity
summary: The SDK count controls init/shutdown loops indexing devices[8] without a capacity bound; nine enumerated cameras can access outside the array. Cap before allocation and every array loop, ignoring/rejecting excess devices, then test with a fake SDK count9. Distinct from existing Andor mutex findings000019/000020. Local SDK/device prerequisite; no remote exploit or hardware execution claimed. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
